arguments.rule_content:
rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dropped_DLL {
    meta:
        description = "Detects dropped Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs in temp directories"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1055, T1218.011"
        filetype = "dll"
        severity = 10
    strings:
        $x64_header = "This program must be run under Win64" wide ascii
        $cfg_pattern = { 2E 72 ? ? ? ? 00 00 00 00 [24] 00 00 00 00 } // .rsrc section + 24-byte null + 8-byte size
        $beacon_mutex = "Global\\MSCTF.Asm.{" wide
        $beacon_regkey = "Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\SysUpdate" wide
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $x64_header and $cfg_pattern and ($beacon_mutex or $beacon_regkey)
        and filename matches /(?i)\\AppData\\(Local|Roaming)\\Temp\\.*\\.dll$/
}

title: Execution of rundll32.exe Loading DLL from Temp Directory
id: 8a9d0f8e-1b2c-4d3e-9f8a-1b2c3d4e5f6a
description: Detects rundll32 loading unsigned DLLs from user temp directories, commonly seen in fileless malware and C2 loaders.
status: experimental
author: SOC_Team
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/011/
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1218.011
    - attack.defense_evasion
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\\rundll32.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 
            - '%TEMP%'
            - '%AppData%'
            - '\\Local\\Temp\\'
        LoadedDLLs|contains: 
            - '%TEMP%'
            - '%AppData%'
            - '\\Local\\Temp\\'
    filter_signed:
        Signed: 'false'
    condition: selection and not filter_signed
level: high
